title: Caffeine
body:
Caffeine is a modpack containing decent collection of mods, it's focused on improving vanilla experience, designed to be simple and not include performance breaking or any mods add new stuff, while providing a nice experience without ruining the vanilla experience too much, the modpack is on top of [Additive]([https://modrinth.com/modpack/adrenaline](https://modrinth.com/modpack/additive)) so it will run quite well. # 📥 Installation Guide Please be sure to read the section of Sodium's wiki [Driver Compatibility](https://github.com/CaffeineMC/sodium/wiki/Driver-Compatibility) before installing Caffeine. It contains some important notes on how to avoid crashes and other performance issues. You can install the modpack with a third party launchers like [Prism Launcher](https://prismlauncher.org/), [Modrinth App](https://modrinth.com/app) or [ATLauncher](https://atlauncher.com/). After installing the modpack, you can easily add your favorite mods, resource packs, or shaders as long as they are compatible with the version of Minecraft you are playing! # ⭐ Features ### UI improvements There are a lot of UI improvements, which make Minecraft easier to understand and look really nice. When these UI improvements are combined with certain sound mods, the result is quite satisfying. Improvements to the chat system, the smoothness of the interface, and things like the gaps in the interface no longer sticking to the screen like glue! ### A few graphical improvements We focus on capturing a more visually appealing image, with rain effects, the beauty of the other effects, and the effects of the bomb explosion, aiming to achieve this without overly compromising the vanilla appearance. ### Sound enhancements Have you ever felt lonely while playing Minecraft because the sounds coming from outside or from the cave seemed like nothing at all? This pack includes a ton of improvements for ambient sounds from outdoor sounds to rain sounds and even echoes. #
